newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish airline Ryanair floats on Irish SE and NASDA.
newsitem.headline: Irish airline Ryanair floats on Irish SE and NASDA.

text.p: Irish low-cost airline Ryanair announced on Tuesday that it was floating on the Irish stock exchange and on Nasdaq.
Ryanair announced that it intends to seek a listing for its shares through an offering of approximately 54.2 million shares at an offer price of between 165 to 195 Irish pence.
It said the market capitalisation of the company at the offer price will be between 261.2 million to 308.7 million Irish pounds.
Ryanair, which describes itself as the pioneer of the no-frills, low fares concept in Europe, has been operating for 12 years and has a fleet of 17 Boeing 737-200 aircraft.
Speculation that the company would seek a listing mounted after U.S. entrepreneur David Bonderman became Ryanair chairman in 1996 after taking the 20 percent stake in the airline.
